mA_churn.reason: Git cannot measure the churn exactly. SL-1 and SL-2 each landed as a single commit (960146b^..960146b adds 6014 lines, 39 files, with no earlier cdp6-core history; 960146b..1d04d1a is 1 commit). The sl2-pre-* snapshots cover only the stretch from the end of the first fix (run 41, plus the orchestrator's C9 contract change) to the final tree. Missing: the trees after T1 (run 32), T2 (run 34), T3 (run 36) and before the first fix. Ledger line 210 says the T3 copy in .worktrees/sl1-audit was replaced by the fixed tree at 01:30. Edits a worker made and then undid inside one run are also invisible. A lower bound can be measured.
mA_churn.method: Lower bound. Run git diff --no-index --no-renames --numstat over consecutive trees in ledger order and sum the inserted lines: 960146b-tree -> sl2-pre-fix2 (ledger 217/220) -> sl2-pre-tmp (before run 45, ledger 223) -> sl2-pre-fix3 (229) -> sl2-pre-fix4 (236) -> sl2-pre-build (245) -> sl2-pre-fix5 (250) -> sl2-pre-fix6 (255) -> sl2-pre-fix7 (260) -> sl2-pre-fix8 (265) -> 1d04d1a-tree. Inserted per step: 4023, 543, 113, 255, 229, 581, 120, 28, 35, 17; sum 5944 (deleted 352). The 960146b->1d04d1a direct numstat is 5735/143, so the chain endpoints are consistent. Stage 1 (SL-1 + SL-2): inserted = 6014 (SL-1 commit, no churn visible) + 5944 = 11958; final lines = 11606; ratio 1.0303 (lower bound). SL-2 alone: 5944 / 5735 lines SL-2 inserted into the final tree = 1.0364, or 5944 / 5592 net growth = 1.0629. Both bounds are below the 1.5 stop value, but because they are lower bounds they cannot clear the condition.

mB_churn.method: Partly measurable, and only as a lower bound. Ran git diff --no-index --numstat on consecutive full trees in ledger order and summed the insertions: 960146b extract -> .worktrees/sl2-pre-fix2 (01:56:54, rebuilt 09:28:29) -> sl2-pre-tmp (between run 44 and run 45; the ledger gives no copy time, only the diff baseline of the 09:44:42 check) -> sl2-pre-fix3 (09:58:12) -> sl2-pre-fix4 (10:27:26) -> sl2-pre-build (12:54:00) -> sl2-pre-fix5 (13:32:54) -> sl2-pre-fix6 (16:03:10) -> sl2-pre-fix7 (18:01:53) -> sl2-pre-fix8 (19:42:29) -> 1d04d1a extract. est.concept_text: Measured stage-1 lines (ledger 0021, 2026-11-04). The lines were counted with the counting rule above, using the sources named in §1.3 at 74d17c8; twelve CDP6 files have such a source, and every other file, tests included, counts in full. The SL-1 build (`plugins/cdp6-core` at 960146b, 39 files, 6014 lines) has 85 copied and 5929 new or changed lines, 2109 of them outside test files. The SL-1 plus SL-2 build (1d04d1a, 67 files, 11606 lines) has 287 copied and 11319 new or changed lines, 3363 outside test files; test files are `*.test.mjs`, `test-support/` and `lib/capture-fixture.mjs`. SL-2 alone, by difference, has 202 copied and 5390 new or changed lines, 1254 outside test files. Commands: `git archive <commit> plugins/cdp6-core` and `git archive 74d17c8 plugins/cdp5-agents`, then `git diff --no-index --numstat <cdp5 file> <cdp6 file>` for each copied file and `git diff --no-index --numstat /dev/null <cdp6 file>` for every other file. Cross-checks: `git diff --shortstat 960146b^ 1d04d1a -- plugins/cdp6-core` gives 11606 insertions, and `git diff --shortstat 960146b 1d04d1a -- plugins/cdp6-core` gives 5735 insertions and 143 deletions. Both counts are above the threshold of the §11.3 stop row "new or changed lines of SL-1 and SL-2 above 3200 (1.2 × the upper estimates of the table, 1850 + 800 ...), or inserted per final lines above 1.5", so the row fires and its action applies: "re-estimate the line figures of stage 2 with the measured ratio". The counting rule excludes no file, so the ratio counts test files. It uses the base of the stop row's threshold: measured ratio = 11319 / (1850 + 800) = 4.27. Each stage-2 range is re-estimated by multiplying both bounds by 4.2713 and rounding: SL-2b 854–1709, SL-3 3203–4912, SL-4 4698–7688, SL-5 4271–6834, SL-6 5126–8116, SL-7 3844–5980, SL-8 2776–4698, SL-9 1922–3203, SL-10 3631–5766, SL-11 4271–6834. Stage 2 thus goes from 8100–13050 to 34598–55741 lines, or 30326–48907 without SL-11. Outside test files the ratio is 3363 / 2650 = 1.27, and stage 2 becomes 10279–16561. Against the midpoint 2175 of the SL-1 and SL-2 estimates, the ratios are 5.20 with tests and 1.55 without. The measured copied lines are much lower than planned: 202 in SL-2 against the planned 1296. Inserted lines, summed over the SL-2 snapshots `.worktrees/sl2-pre-*` in ledger order with `git diff --no-index --no-renames --numstat` per step, are 5944. SL-1 plus SL-2 therefore inserted at least 6014 + 5944 = 11958 lines for 11606 final lines, a ratio of 1.03. This is only a lower bound, because SL-1 has a single commit and no snapshots and edits within a run are not visible, so the churn limb of the stop row neither fires nor is cleared.
